name: pokemap-reference-builder
description: Reconstruct exterior references, review outdoor asset assemblies and prototype interior shells before PokeMap authoring.

interface.shortDescription: Rebuild exteriors and prototype interior shells.
interface.longDescription: Builds assisted semantic blueprints from exterior references and read-only HTML floor-and-wall prototypes for interiors. Includes research-backed placement guidance and seven native-source examples for forest closures, cliffs, stairs, bridges, docks, waterfalls and aquatic rocks. Distinguishes ground support, visual overhang and collision, with explicit exceptions and tool limits. Exterior reconstruction retains its fidelity gates and canonical PokeMap MCP workflow.
defaultPrompt: Rebuild this exterior reference as an editable PokeMap map.
Prototype this interior's floors and walls in HTML before changing the project.
Decode this map image into semantic 32 px layers.
Review terrain support and modular asset placement using the bundled assembly examples.
Create a correctly sized missing HGSS-style asset.
Compare this PokeMap render with its reference and block it below the quality gate.
